name: Achari Paneer Skewers
ingredients: ½ tsp each fennel, nigella (kalonji), cumin and mustard seeds, coarsely crushed
½ tsp chilli powder and ¼ tsp turmeric
steps: Mix the yogurt, mustard oil, crushed seeds, chilli, turmeric, lemon and salt. Coat the paneer and vegetables and marinate for 30 minutes.
Cook on a hot grill pan or in a 220°C oven for 12–15 minutes, turning, until lightly charred.
note: The pickle-spice mix gives the tangy flavour of achari without any jarred oil pickle.
